notes.title: Selected bundle of text-based adventure games!
notes.content: [p]《Song of Feathers 》*《Fragrant Love Ready! 》The joint bundle has now been logged into Steam![/p][p]This bundle includes two distinctly different styles of text-based adventure games, meeting your expectations for text-based adventure games! Welcome everyone to experience![/p][p]Regarding 《Fragrant Love Ready! 》! [/p][p]How to translate[/p][p]In a mundane life, as the owner of a fragrance store, you run your own fragrance store. Until one day, a sudden accident involved you in an investigation into your own life and death. In constant contact with three employees of the "Human Soul Transfer Center," the truth gradually surfaced - a love affair about fragrance. Are you ready? Harvest your own heartbeat memories in the game![/p][p]Regarding the 《Song of Feathers 》[/p][p]《Song of Feathers 》 is a deeply immersive post apocalyptic survival adventure game. In this world shrouded in the shadow of the apocalypse, the once prosperous and legendary human civilization now only has fragmented memories scattered among endless ruins. Players will play as the last human in this desperate land, searching for the meaning of survival and the opportunity to rebuild civilization.[/p]

notes.title: "Song of Feathers" will be published on March 31st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502787/e3cd1f3513135c90b2ce13f91613c6ac9c6aeb20.jpg[/img]"Song of Feathers" will officially launch on March 31st. We extend our sincere gratitude to all players for your support.

As this marks our first attempt at a self-developing and self-publishing, we recognize there were shortcomings in our promotional efforts. We deeply appreciate the enthusiastic feedback and suggestions from our players, and we are committed to learn from this experience to improve in the future.

"Song of Feathers" is a project with our dedication and enthusiasm. We hope our players will enjoy this work. Post-launch, we will continue to update and refine the game based on players' feedback.

If you encounter any issues during gameplay—whether bugs or narrative concerns—please join our player community (QQ Group: 183930450) to share your feedback.

Finally, we wish you an exhilarating experience. Dive into the apocalyptic carnage and enjoy the battle!
We do have plans on English translation, we will keep you updated.
